subject: english
question:
**Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that arranges the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.**

A) he has been

B) everyone he knows

C) so upset about his

D) him so rude to

E) divorce and that made
solution:
The correct answer is: **A, C, E, D, B.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **A- "He has been"**: This part sets the subject and introduces a state or condition.
 
• **C- "So upset about his"**: This part provides more information about the subject's emotional state, giving context to the upcoming events.
 
• **E- "Divorce and that made"**: This part introduces the reason for the subject's emotional state, explaining what caused him to be upset.
 
• **D- "Him so rude to"**: This part describes a consequence of the emotional state mentioned earlier, indicating the effect of his upset feelings.
 
• **B- "Everyone he knows"**: This part concludes the sentence by specifying the scope of the impact, indicating that his emotional state has affected those around him.
 
• So, when arranged in the sequence **A, C, E, D, B** the parts form a coherent and meaningful sentence with a clear flow of events and information.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.
